name: iic-device-transfer
why: AppleARMIICDevice transfer (vtable slot 0x35c: op, sub-address, data) -> shim_iic_transfer: a register file per I2C device instead of a bus that does not exist (Thumb: nop; bx pc; nop; ARM: ldr pc,[pc,#-4]; .word)

name: i2s-start-no-lrck-sync
why: AppleS5L8900XI2SController DMA start (0x8066d448): for i2s-version 0 with frame sync it sets state 1, enables its GPIO interrupt (i2s0 'interrupts' 0x2c on the GPIO controller) and sleeps until two edges took the state 1->2->3 (action 0x8066caf0) or the timeout set 4 (0x8066cb84) -> kIOReturnNotReady, 'could not start DMA: device is not ready'. Nothing raises that GPIO interrupt on the 3DS: start in state 3 (synced), so the wait loop falls through and the interrupt is disabled and the timeout cancelled as on success (mov r3,#1 -> mov r3,#3)
